publisher: Devon County Council / Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record
data_date: layer metadata accessed 2026-10-06; metadata states central Exeter records are out of date
evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official public ArcGIS MapServer layer 669 is named Listed buildings, has esriGeometryPolygon geometry, supports GeoJSON queries, and exposes record fields including ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, NGR and NHLE_URL. The layer is maintained by the Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record using Historic England data, and its metadata states that records in central Exeter are out of date. A new exact-record public no-login query for ListEntry 1266928 with returnGeometry=true was attempted, but no feature payload was retrievable through the available retrieval channel. Therefore no polygon coordinates or record-bound Name/type-use/Grade values were accepted or inferred.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 669 is an esriGeometryPolygon layer and supports GeoJSON query responses, but the exact ListEntry 1266928 response was not retrievable, so no polygon coordinates were accepted.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer metadata exposes a Name field, but the exact record payload was not retrievable; no Name/type-use value was inferred.
field_evidence.heritage: Official layer metadata exposes ListEntry and Grade fields and states the layer is maintained by Devon & Dartmoor HER from Historic England data; exact record values were not read from the blocked response.
